reason: Sharp contrasting serif terminals and substantial stroke weight match the original dark moon/crimson brush identity. Chosen after actual libass frame comparisons with MaruBuri SemiBold and Noto Serif600.
license_delivery_rule: Rasterized video/image text only; do not redistribute or embed the Eulyoo font file in the game or patch. Internal build font stays in research.
fallback_policy: Explicit Noto Serif font run; never arbitrary Windows fallback.
